applicableClauses.note: A tablet that no longer powers on during normal use is a manufacturing defect covered by this clause.
Purchased in North America: 12-month warranty period. warranty_lookup reports the claim date within standard coverage.
The battery period does not apply; the reported failure is not a battery fault.
No drop, impact or screen damage reported or visible.
No liquid contact reported or visible.

structuredOutput.summary: Covered: a spontaneous power failure is a manufacturing defect under POL-8, and the claim is within the 12-month North America warranty period of POL-1 as computed by warranty_lookup. No exclusion (POL-4, POL-5) applies.
